scope: Bounded live fixtures for the remaining pricing cases: special illustration rare, English promo, and unavailable per-variant TCGplayer price. No full catalog was downloaded.

records.fixture_source: Previously fetched and captured in tcgdex-pricing-samples.json; reused to avoid repeating an ordinary Energy request.
records.name: Fire Energy

interpretation.tcgplayer_market_price: For sv03-223, the detailed variant includes a USD marketPrice of 99.18 and productId 509980. This is what TCGdex currently returns; it does not independently confirm the marketplace listing's physical variant mapping.
interpretation.explicit_null: For svp-085 and two base1-98 variants, the detailed variant has pricing.tcgplayer explicitly null. This means no TCGplayer quote is present at that nesting point; it does not mean the entire card or variant record is absent.
interpretation.missing_field: The base1-98 1999-2000-copyright variant has no pricing field in the captured detailed entry. The fixture records that absence separately from explicit null.
interpretation.product_id_caution: thirdParty.tcgplayer is a marketplace product reference. It is not proof that the associated listing describes this exact physical printing; verify the listing before treating a quote as exact-edition value.
